results.question: List the first ten track names.
Show customers in Canada, ordered by last name.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE Country = ? ORDER BY LastName

results.question: How many albums does each artist have? Show the top ten.
results.sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist LEFT JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Which genre has the most tracks?
results.sql: SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is total invoice revenue for each year?
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year

results.question: Show monthly revenue for 2013.
results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(Total) AS Revenue FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = ? GROUP BY Month

results.question: Which customers have spent more than 50 dollars?
results.sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Invoice.Total > ?

results.question: Show the ten best-selling tracks by quantity.
results.sql: SELECT Track.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Track.TrackId ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: Which country generated the most invoice revenue?
results.sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many customers does each employee support?
results.sql: SELECT Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee LEFT JOIN Customer ON Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId

results.question: List artists that do not have any albums.
results.sql: SELECT Artist.Name FROM Artist LEFT JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId WHERE Album.AlbumId IS NULL

results.question: Find tracks longer than the average track duration.
results.sql: WITH AverageDuration AS (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) AS AvgDuration FROM Track) SELECT * FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AvgDuration FROM AverageDuration)

results.question: Show invoices over 20 dollars from 2012, newest first.
results.sql: SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE Total > ? AND STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = ? ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC

results.question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
results.sql: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.Name

results.question: Show the top five countries by number of customers.
results.sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC LIMIT 5
